specs.Compatible Devices: Easily transmit audio from TV to Bluetooth Headphones or Bluetooth Speakers
specs.Compatibility Options: TV, PC, Car Stereo, Home Stereo, Wired Speaker, Bluetooth Headphones, Bluetooth Speakers, MP3/MP4 Players

features: 【2-In-1 Bluetooth Transmitter Receiver】C41 is a compact Bluetooth Audio Transceiver, it can upgrade your old TV, PC, speaker, home stereo or car stereo system. In the transmitter mode(TX), it can make the old TV/PC transmit wireless audio signals to your Bluetooth headset/speaker. In the receiver mode( RX), it can receive the favorite music from your cellphone, then play by the traditional wired speaker stereo or car audio system
[Bluetooth Transmitter for TV] In TX mode, our Blutooth audio adapter can retrofit non-Bluetooth-devices such as PC/TV with Bluetooth and send audio stream to Bluetooth speakers/ headphones

[Multiple output interfaces] After receiving the audio source information through Bluetooth, it is then inputted to your final audio device through various selectable output interfaces. Fiber optic, coaxial, RCA, Aux and other interfaces can almost meet all customer needs. At the same time, we also support playing MP3 and WAV format music on TF cards.
[LCD displays] all the operation processes, which can be visualized through LCD. The operation is very user-friendly and simple
[66 feet long range]After a special technological upgrade, the antenna performance has been enhanced, and the Bluetooth distance has been extended to 20 meters.
[Multiple accessories] In TX mode, we can use the Optical/Aux/RCA/Coaxial interfaca,and in RX mode, we can use TF card/aux audio interface.
